# Freedom Room

> > Premium outdoor living structures and pergola kits designed for residential and resort applications.

Freedom Room specializes in high-quality timber frame pergolas, pavilions, and outdoor living structures based in Austin, TX. The company offers both pre-designed kits and custom solutions using materials like Western Red Cedar and composite decking.
